name: Luce Yami Astalité
original_name: ルーチェ・ヤミ・アスタリテ
source:
"I swore to you first... Not like that matters, anyway."

Luce Yami Astalité is a vampire princess that prefers to go by Luce. She addresses those around her in an icy and somewhat sassy tone. 

Even those with an ironclad will kneel at her feet when confronted with her noble, yet audacious, charm. Her confidence is a barbed arrow with deadly precision, though those who meet her come to learn of her authentic nature. 

Luce has traveled to the human world to fulfill the love pact she made with [url=/c14905]Yuuta[/url]. 

She intended to hold a ceremony the second they reunited, but is rudely interrupted by some competition. Despite the unforeseen impasse, she remains absolutely convinced that she is Yuuta’s true love. 

She will be entering Shinonome Academy as a 2nd year student.

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1049]MangaGamer[/url]]
